narr: A cold front drifted into the region and stalled across central Louisiana. Thunderstorms developed along the boundary during the afternoon and evening of the 5th with one becoming severe.
ev: Roadways in the Grundy Cooper Neighborhood of Alexandria were flooded and some were impassable.
lsr: Photo received via social media of flooded roadways in the Grundy Cooper neighborhood of Alexandria. Road impassible. Delayed report.
